event.description: Interleave LSB-first operand digits and remove the unused plus token
event.proposal: Family: token representation. Current retained frontier is 5,824 parameters at 99.900000%, a +0.900000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There are 0 prior attempts in this family, so no most recent accepted or failed in-family result exists. Attempts-0003 and -0004 were position-representation optimization failures and motivate changing mechanism rather than further rank reduction. Hypothesis: arranging each least-significant-first operand column as adjacent token pairs gives attention a simpler column-local input geometry; removing the redundant plus separator/token coherently shortens the sequence by one and removes one tied vocabulary vector, yielding 5,792 parameters. This is a representational change, not pruning. It is more informative than the nearest untested alternative of merely reversing the two operand blocks because interleaving directly tests whether column adjacency improves the learned addition mechanism. A step-15,000 below-50% validation abort, calibrated from the accepted path versus the two stalled paths, bounds clearly failed optimization.
